integrity: The transfer-current input is attributed; all-size derivations are given explicitly; six exact finite enumerations are supplementary checks, not infinite certification.
limitations: The probability law is uniform over spanning trees of complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two.
The prediction statement concerns affine/linear predictors, not arbitrary nonlinear conditional expectation.
General transfer-current identities are prior results; priority of the evaluated all-size spectrum remains subject to independent historical review.
source_date_note: The initial arXiv posting on 2004-04-02 is the earliest source date verified to day precision in the cited accessible material. An earlier 1993 journal version exists, but its first public day is not claimed to have been established.
title: Exact variance geometry of uniform bipartite spanning trees
